name: Grafana
setup:
Signs Home Assistant users in to Grafana: admins become Grafana admins, everyone else viewer. Add to `grafana.ini` (or the matching `GF_…` environment variables) and restart Grafana:

```ini
[server]
root_url = %(protocol)s://%(domain)s{base}/
serve_from_sub_path = true

[auth.proxy]
enabled = true
header_name = Remote-User
header_property = username
auto_sign_up = true
headers = Role:Remote-Role
whitelist = <IP of Home Assistant>
```

The `whitelist` matters: only Home Assistant may send the login headers. With `serve_from_sub_path` Grafana answers under this path only, also when opened directly.
